items.title: Monthly call with Northstar Ventures (lead investor)
items.body: Attendees: Lena, Mara Keller (Northstar). Summary: Mara is happy with the September update. Action item: 'Please include net revenue retention (NRR) in the next update, our partners look at it for the Series A.'

facts.text: Lead investor (Mara, Northstar Ventures) asked for NRR in the next update

items.title: Procurement call with FreshMart Nord
items.body: Attendees: Lena, Head of Procurement FreshMart Nord. Summary: pilot contract terms agreed, 12 stores, kick-off Oct 13.

facts.text: Procurement call with FreshMart Nord: pilot terms agreed, kick-off Oct 13

items.title: Interview: Senior ML Engineer (candidate 1)
items.body: Attendees: Tom, Lena, candidate. Summary: strong forecasting background, second round next week. Pipeline for the role is thin, more referrals needed.

facts.text: Interviewing for a senior ML engineer; candidate pipeline is thin

items.title: FreshMart Nord pilot review
items.body: Attendees: Lena, FreshMart Nord Head of Operations. Summary: Store managers report 18% less fresh produce waste in week 2. 'If this holds we want to roll out to 40 stores in Q1.' No commitment or contract yet.

facts.text: FreshMart Nord wants to roll out to 40 stores in Q1
